How it works

Choose a task. Add a file. Make it yours—all in your browser.

  1. Choose your tool

    Browse the catalog by task, or search the workspace’s 88 tools. Merge, organize, convert, edit, protect and inspect documents from one place.

    Explore PDF tools

  2. Add a file from your device

    Use Choose files or drag a supported document into the workspace. Your selected document is read locally; there is no document-upload endpoint. Check the tool’s file type and options before processing.

  3. Process, download and review

    Set page ranges, text, passwords or other options, then run the tool. Some tools display a report or preview; others create a download. Keep your original and open the result to check it.

Your document’s journey

  1. Your device
  2. Browser workspace
  3. Local processing
  4. Download or report

The host delivers the app and controls private access. Selected documents are processed on your device. OCR can download an English language model; browser AI tools may download their own models. Read about network requests and storage.

Before you process

The beta limit is 100 MB per file; your device may support less. Office conversions have layout limits, AI summary and translation depend on browser support, and redaction remains experimental. Verified sanitization and PDF/A conversion are unavailable. Check the full tool limitations.

If something doesn’t work

Keep the original and read the workspace error. Check the supported format and options, or try a smaller file. A password-protected file may need the Unlock tool and its password. Unsupported browser AI reports an error instead of a completed download.

To stop a running job, choose Cancel and confirm the tab reload. This clears selected files and unsaved settings. Work cannot be resumed from that point.

Common questions

Does FolioCove upload my PDF?

Selected documents are processed in your browser. The application has no document-upload endpoint. The host serves assets and controls private access; OCR and browser AI may download language models.

Can I use the AI tools in every browser?

No. AI summary and translation require supported browser APIs and local models. If a model is unavailable, the tool reports an error. Smart summary provides a local extractive alternative.

Does FolioCove preserve Office layouts?

Office conversion has fidelity limits. DOCX exports selectable text, XLSX exports extracted rows, and PDF-to-PowerPoint places page images on slides. Full editable layout reconstruction is unavailable.

Is FolioCove ready for sensitive documents?

This remains a private beta for synthetic or non-sensitive documents. Redaction is experimental; verified sanitization and validated PDF/A conversion are unavailable. Keep originals and independently inspect outputs.

Current beta status

FolioCove is ready for a controlled private pilot with synthetic or non-sensitive documents. Public launch is pending a working support inbox, finished public notices and a short real-device pilot. Operator name: FolioCove. Country: India. The public support email has not yet been set up.

View validation and pilot details

The focused local audit on 2 October 2026 exercised all 88 catalog tools: 75 produced structurally parseable downloads, 10 displayed reports or previews, and 3 reported expected limitations. The focused Chromium suite passed 37 checks; Chrome/Edge smoke tests passed 6 and mobile viewport checks passed 20. These results do not guarantee accuracy for every document.

A follow-up automated pilot passed 21 checks across Android emulation, iPhone/WebKit emulation and desktop WebKit, including photo import, PDF downloads and visible limits. These are engine/emulation checks, not actual phone or Safari-app tests. Physical phone cameras, native mobile downloads and actual Safari still need pilot checks. Use synthetic files, try one task without guidance and inspect the output. Do not include documents or personal information in feedback.
